whatsappMessage:
Hi Cake Cafe Tales team,

I noticed your cafe has an incredible 5.0★ rating with 56 reviews in Nageshwar Colony, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online menu browsing and cake orders.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme instant WhatsApp cake booking, signature menu, aur location directions integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/cakecafetales

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Cake Cafe Tales team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and your Patna location setup. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact cake varieties, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
